definitions.explanation: A clock or watch that automatically synchronizes its time by receiving radio signals from a time standard transmitter, ensuring high accuracy.

examples.japanese: {電波時計|でんぱどけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧だ。

⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧{電波時計|でんぱどけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: The radio-controlled clock on the wall automatically adjusted the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{電波時計|でんぱどけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my father a radio-controlled wristwatch for his birthday.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧ (radio waves) + {時計|どけい} (clock/watch). In Japan, these clocks receive signals from the JJY transmitter operated by NICT (National Institute of Information and Communications Technology). They are extremely popular in Japan and are a common gift item.

- {電波時計|でんぱどけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧: radio-controlled wristwatch
